description: This file defines API routes for a dashboard backend related to file ingestion and folder mapping. It includes endpoints for uploading files, mapping folders for ingestion, and listing mapped folders using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy ORM, and Pydantic models.

classes.name: FolderMapping
classes.description: Model for folder mapping configuration including path and alias.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the response after a file upload, including filename and status.

methods.name: upload_file(file: UploadFile = File(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles uploading a file, saves it to the 'uploads' directory, and records it in the database if not already present.

methods.name: map_folder(mapping: FolderMapping, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates or updates a folder mapping for ingestion, identified by alias.

methods.name: list_mapped_folders(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a list of all folder mappings currently stored in the database.

ctags.name: FolderMappingORM
ctags.pattern: /^from src.api.models import FolderMapping as FolderMappingORM, UploadedFile as UploadedFileORM$/

ctags.name: UploadedFileORM
ctags.pattern: /^from src.api.models import FolderMapping as FolderMappingORM, UploadedFile as UploadedFileORM$/

ctags.name: alias
ctags.pattern: /^    alias: str = Field(..., description="Custom name\/label for the folder")$/

ctags.name: map_folder
ctags.pattern: /^async def map_folder(mapping: FolderMapping, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^    path: str = Field(..., description="Absolute or relative folder path to monitor")$/

ctags.name: upload_file
ctags.pattern: /^async def upload_file(file: UploadFile = File(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
